requirements.requirement: Independently stipulated developmental ancestry, cell family, genetic clone and cycling state are different labels; no one is inferred from another.
A stipulated clone can occur in cycling and noncycling states, while one RNA-state group can include different clones.
An RNA group or cell shape alone does not establish developmental direction, malignancy or permanent commitment.
Nucleus, cytosol, ER, Golgi, lysosome, mitochondrion, vesicle and cell membrane identify different physical compartments or structures.
The schematic distinguishes free cytosolic ribosomes and ribosomes on the cytosolic face of ER; a branched label does not put ribosomes in the lumen.
Nuclear chromatin and mitochondrial DNA have different depicted locations; the cytosol label is outside membrane-bound organelles.
The selected secreted-protein example follows ER, Golgi and transport-vesicle stages; this is not a route taken by every protein.
The selected cargo remains within membrane-enclosed lumens until outward fusion releases it; intermediate arrows do not establish membrane escape.
A compartment map or preserved geometry does not measure cargo activity, treatment effect or executed trafficking.
Before scission, an inward membrane pocket can remain continuous with extracellular fluid; it does not open directly into cytosol.
After closure, cargo in an internal vesicle lumen is inside the cell but not thereby free in cytosol.
The bilayer follows the inward pocket; a process arrow does not mean that larger cargo crossed the bilayer.
A transmembrane receptor spans the bilayer; its external ligand contact is not itself ligand entry or demonstrated signalling.
Cytosolic delivery or endosomal escape remains a separate question, not a result supplied by an uptake cartoon.
A chemical methyl mark on C does not replace that base with T; a C-to-T substitution changes the sequence.
A DNA mark and a histone-protein mark are on different substrates.
5-methylcytosine and5-hydroxymethylcytosine are different marks, and standard bisulfite sequencing does not distinguish them.
Promoter and gene-body location, cell context and RNA measurements affect interpretation; a mark is not a universal off switch.
A mark or schematic does not establish permanent inheritance, causality, a cell fraction or treatment prediction.
Early constitutional distribution may be inherited or de novo; later changes can be somatic and mosaic. These are not mutually exclusive bins.
The ancestry and sampled-cell windows are illustrative partial histories, not a pedigree or complete reproductive-cell map.
Reproductive contribution and tumour-cell genotypes remain unknown in the stated scenario; unknown cells are not assigned observed variants.
Plasma DNA can have contributors from blood cells and tumour cells; possible-source arrows do not establish origin in an individual sample.
A variant symbol attaches to a depicted DNA fragment, not the tube fluid; plasma DNA fragments are not intact circulating cells.
Four marked and four unmarked DNA icons among eight, and two marked among four blood-cell icons, are fictional object counts rather than measured allele fractions.
The drawing does not establish pathogenicity, functional effect, transmission or a diagnostic origin.
The comparison depicts joined retained-exon segments in a mature message, with opposite5prime/3prime endpoints and a ribosome at a stop.
A retained exon-junction complex downstream of a stop can support an EJC-linked human NMD route; its position relative to the splice junction matters.
NMD is context dependent; a final-exon stop without the depicted downstream EJC is not proof that no NMD occurs.
A stop/EJC snapshot does not establish protein preservation; RNA abundance and protein outcomes require separate measurements.
The generic stop, EJC lobes and exon shapes are schematic, not a quantitative ruler, molecular component count or clinical/immune outcome.
Selected stored V, D and J segments can be joined into a rearranged receptor-gene sequence; a separate VJ chain has no D segment.
Antibody heavy and TCRbeta are VDJ examples, whereas antibody light and TCRalpha are VJ examples; these are not every receptor-chain type.
RAG-mediated cutting and DNA repair joining are separate contributions, and junctional sequence can change.
Gene assembly, receptor expression, developmental selection and later antigen-triggered response are distinct steps; selection must not be portrayed as excluding self-antigen interactions.
Receptor generation is not deliberate antigen targeting; simplified segment choices do not assert real segment counts or spacing.
A RAG variant in mixed tissue does not by itself establish receptor rearrangement in epithelial cells.
Linked amino-acid sequence, a spatial fold and a processed product are different physical forms; folding does not reorder the sequence.
Removal of a terminal segment is one processing example, not a universal definition of all protein processing.
Protein versus peptide terminology has no one universal residue-length boundary.
A measured shared fragment cannot by itself distinguish two stipulated intact products or establish their complete structure/activity.
A possible peptide sequence does not establish actual HLA presentation.
A linked two-domain cartoon can illustrate a contacting interface; annotation on the faces is not a third material or molecule.
A continuous linker and two contacting domains are not a measured interdomain arrangement or observed movement.
Fold, relative arrangement and contact confidence are separate from measured binding affinity or activity.
The fictional contact cartoon does not establish real coordinates, measured disorder, molecular packing or clinical effect.
The illustrated ATCG and TAGC bases are complementary on oppositely oriented5prime/3prime strands.
The paired interior bases are distinct from the sugar/phosphate backbone; a label leader must identify the intended component.
Double-stranded DNA wraps around a histone core; the nucleosome label refers to DNA plus core, not only one component.
The depicted gene is one DNA region within the selected nuclear chromosome, not the whole chromosome.
The nuclear packaging example is schematic and does not impose a universal30nm fibre or an X-shaped chromosome.
A corrected leader or preserved geometry does not establish copy number, gene activity, RNA/protein output or a sequence change.
